tickets.title: My tickets
tickets.greeting: Hi {name} — track and reply to your support requests.
tickets.emptyDescription: Need help with something? We usually reply within an hour.

ticket.notFoundDescription: This ticket doesn't exist, or it isn't shared with your account.
ticket.closedDescription: Closed tickets can't receive replies. Raise a new ticket if you still need help.

live.reconnecting: Reconnecting… new replies will appear as soon as you're back online.
live.offline: Live updates are paused. Reload the page to see new replies.

reply.label: Your reply
reply.hint: We’ll email you when an engineer responds.
reply.uploadsPending: Wait for the attachments to finish uploading.
reply.uploadsFailed: Remove or retry the attachments that failed.

help.title: Help center
help.emptyDescription: We’re preparing answers to common questions. In the meantime, open a ticket and our team will help you directly.
help.stillNeedDescription: Open a ticket and our team will pick it up.
